It actively collects this week's work items from the user, organizes them into three columns (完成 / 进行中 / 计划), enforces a per-item limit of 15 Chinese characters and a total report limit of 300 characters, and outputs a clean, copy-paste-ready format suitable for team chat tools.
skills.name: work-skill
